{{Top}}
{{Quote|Someone really liked bugs, I guess. I wonder how they'd feel if they knew their art had ended up as a mound of moss.|Zak Arranda, describing a statue in the [[Sikadian Garden]]|<ref name="Galaxy of Fear: The Swarm">''[[Galaxy of Fear: The Swarm]]''</ref>}}
'''Mosses''' were a type of soft,<ref name="Galaxy of Fear: Spore">''[[Galaxy of Fear: Spore]]''</ref> slippery plant.<ref name="Galaxy of Fear: The Hunger">''[[Galaxy of Fear: The Hunger]]''</ref>

Moss could cover virtually any surface, growing everywhere from [[City/Legends|city]] streets<ref name="COJ">[[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']]</ref> to walls,<ref name="Darth Maul: Shadow Hunter">''[[Darth Maul: Shadow Hunter]]''</ref> from rocks<ref name="COJ" /> to [[Tree/Legends|trees]],<ref name="DN3">''[[Dark Nest III: The Swarm War]]''</ref> and from forests<ref name="DN1">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref> to [[Starship/Legends|spacecraft]].<ref name="Slaying Dragons">{{JournalCite|9|Slaying Dragons}}</ref> It even covered the thoraxes of the [[Kolosolok]] race of [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]].<ref name="DN3" /> While moss primarily grew in the wild, especially in humid air,<ref name="Galaxy of Fear: Planet Plague">''[[Galaxy of Fear: Planet Plague]]''</ref> it had a variety of uses. The [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Ob Khaddor]] produced a [[Moss painting/Legends|moss painting]] known as ''[[Killik Twilight]]'',<ref name="Tatooine Ghost">''[[Tatooine Ghost]]''</ref> and some species could eat moss as a last-resort source of sustenance.<ref name="Galaxy of Fear: The Hunger" />

==Colors==
*[[Color/Legends|Gray]]<ref name="COJ" />
*Green<ref name="Bane of the Sith">{{GamerCite|3|Bane of the Sith}}</ref>
*White<ref name="Vision of the Future">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[Wikipedia:Sphagnum|Sphagnum]] moss was used in the construction of the [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] miniature set for [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']].<ref name="SWArchive-Building Felucia">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iii/bts/production/f20060807/index.html|text=Building Felucia}}</ref>
